newsitem.title: HONDURAS: IDB monitors Honduras energy privatization.
newsitem.headline: IDB monitors Honduras energy privatization.

text.p: A mission from the Interamerican Development Bank (IDB) arrived in Honduras on Monday to monitor advances in the proposed privatization and restructuring of the state-owned electric company known as ENEE.
ENEE, the largest of Honduras's government enterprises, has assets calculated at $1.4 billion. The IDB is withholding $20 million in aid pending the ENEE privatization.

"The mission is coming to evaluate how the financial administration and restructuing of ENEE is progressing," IDB official Rolando Young told reporters. "There will be a review of the program to reduce losses to see how it's working."
Honduras also is privatizing its state-owned telephone and water utilities.
